method: Every date came from a web search result or a fetched page on 2026-11-17. 'source' is the page the dates were read from. Where the official page could not be opened directly (HTTP 402/403), the date was read from the search-result excerpt of that official page and the note says so.

series.standing: THE primary annual meeting for US nephrology
series.note: Official page fetched. Oct 21 / Oct 27 are Early Programs days; the annual meeting proper starts one day later (2026: Oct 22-25).

series.organizer: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists
series.standing: THE primary annual meeting for US OB-GYN generalists (subspecialty meetings such as SMFM and SGO are separate)
series.attendance: ~5,000-6,000 (2026: ACOG opening-day release said 'more than 6,000'; Contemporary OB/GYN post-meeting recap said ~5,000)
series.note: 2027 dates read from search excerpts of annualmeeting.acog.org (acog.org itself returned HTTP 402 to a direct fetch). Pre-meeting courses Thursday 2027-05-20. Attendance sources disagree (5,000 vs 6,000+).

series.standing: THE primary annual meeting for urology (AUA calls it the largest gathering of urologists in the world)
series.note: A San Diego tourism microsite lists May 24-27, 2027; AUA's own exhibitor pages and style guide both say May 21-24, 2027, which is used here. Same dates as ACOG 2027.

series.standing: THE primary annual meeting for orthopedics
series.note: 2027 shortened to four days (Wed-Sat); a third-party listing showing Mar 2-6, 2027 is stale. Attendance left null: the AAOS 2026 final-attendance PDF (linked) showed 3,291 US physicians attending and what looked like a 7,516 total, but the extracted text was garbled and the total could not be confirmed. Aggregator claims of 30,000+ are unverified.

series.audience: Spine surgeons and other spine-care clinicians
series.standing: Subspecialty meeting: the main spine-specific annual meeting (spine also appears at AAOS and the neurosurgery meetings AANS/CNS)
series.note: Official spine.org page fetched: Sept 23-25, 2027, Boston (Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center). A third-party listing (luminik.io) shows Sept 22-25, 2027 in San Antonio - that is wrong. One NASS 2026 exhibitor prospectus lists Oct 14-16 (exhibit days). Only attendance figure found was an aggregator's '6,500+', not used.

series.standing: THE primary annual meeting for neurology
series.note: Hybrid (in person plus online). Same dates as the APA (psychiatry) 2027 meeting.

series.audience: Alzheimer's and dementia researchers and clinicians
series.standing: Disease-specific: the largest dementia research meeting; 1 of 3 main Alzheimer's meetings (with CTAD and AD/PD)
series.attendance: ~11,000 (2025: 'more than 11,000 attendees', per NIHR Dementia Researcher; no 2026 figure found)
series.note: Official page fetched. July 22, 2027 is a separate 'AAIC For All: Clinicians' day, so some pages show July 18-22; the annual conference itself is July 18-21. Attendance figure is second-hand (not from alz.org).

series.full_name: Clinical Trials on Alzheimer's Disease (CTAD) Conference
series.organizer: CTAD (Clinical Trials on Alzheimer's Disease congress organization)
series.audience: Alzheimer's drug developers, trialists and investors following Alzheimer's readouts
series.standing: Disease-specific: the clinical-trials-focused Alzheimer's meeting; 1 of 3 main Alzheimer's meetings (with AAIC and AD/PD)
series.note: NOT VERIFIED. CTAD 2026 began 2026-11-16, one day before the cutoff, and is IN PROGRESS today (through 2026-11-19) - recorded under 'last'. The official site lists only the 2026 meeting; no dates or city for CTAD 2027 are published anywhere found. No attendance figure found (site says in-person registration is at capacity).

series.standing: THE primary annual clinical meeting for ophthalmology (ARVO is the research meeting; ASCRS and ASRS are subspecialty meetings)
series.note: Dates read from search excerpts of AAO's 'Locations and Dates of Future Meetings' page (direct fetch returned HTTP 403). The Nov 12 / Oct 9 start includes Subspecialty Day; expo runs from the second day. Do not confuse with the orthodontists' 'AAO Annual Session' (Vancouver, June 2027). Only attendance figure found was an aggregator's '25,000+', not used.

series.organizer: Association for Research in Vision and Ophthalmology
series.audience: Eye and vision researchers (scientists and clinician-scientists)
series.standing: THE primary eye-RESEARCH meeting; 1 of 2 big ophthalmology meetings (AAO is the clinical one)
series.note: Dates read from search excerpts of arvo.org pages (direct fetch returned HTTP 403). Exhibits May 2-5, 2027; an 'All-Access Saturday' on May 1, 2027 precedes the meeting. Attendance source URL is the best-matching arvo.org page from the search, not opened directly.

series.audience: Retina specialists (ophthalmologists who treat retinal disease)
series.standing: Subspecialty meeting: the main retina meeting (others: Retina Society, Macula Society, AAO Retina Subspecialty Day)
series.note: asrs.org states 'July 28-31 in San Francisco' without the year; the year 2027 is confirmed by the Moscone Center listing (https://moscone.com/events/american-society-retina-specialists-annual-meeting-2027). No attendance figure found.

series.standing: THE primary annual meeting for US rheumatology (EULAR is the European counterpart)
series.note: Official page fetched for 2027. Third-party listings still show 2027 as TBD - they are stale. Attendance left null: only unofficial projections found (13,000+ and ~16,800), which disagree.

series.organizer: Jointly sponsored by the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases, American Gastroenterological Association, American Society for Gastrointestinal Endoscopy and Society for Surgery of the Alimentary Tract
series.audience: Gastroenterologists, liver doctors, endoscopists and GI surgeons
series.standing: THE primary annual meeting for US gastroenterology (ACG's annual meeting is the second; AASLD's Liver Meeting covers hepatology)
series.attendance: ~14,000 ('14,000+' annual attendance, per DDW by the Numbers)
series.note: Official page fetched. ddw.org says 'May 15-18, 2027, in Washington, D.C., and online' but one block on the same page still says 'Chicago for DDW 2027' - leftover 2026 copy; every other source says Washington, DC. Dates are consistent everywhere.

series.organizer: American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases
series.standing: THE primary annual meeting for US hepatology (EASL Congress is the European counterpart)
series.note: Start date confirmed on aasld.org/the-liver-meeting ('First Day of TLM27 in Philadelphia, PA' on Nov 12, 2027). END date (Nov 16) comes only from a search excerpt of the AASLD 2026 program guide PDF, which was not opened directly - treat the end date as lower-confidence. Third-party listings still show TBD. No attendance figure found.

series.audience: Lung doctors (pulmonologists), critical-care and sleep physicians, lung researchers
series.standing: 1 of 2 primary US pulmonary meetings (the other is CHEST; ATS is the more research-heavy one); ERS Congress is the European counterpart
series.note: Official page fetched for 2027 (conference.thoracic.org now redirects to site.thoracic.org/conference). Attendance source URL is the best-matching thoracic.org page from the search, not opened directly.

series.audience: Lung doctors (pulmonologists), critical-care and sleep clinicians
series.standing: 1 of 2 primary US pulmonary meetings (the other is ATS; CHEST is the more clinical one)
series.note: 2027 dates read from search excerpts of chestnet.org ('2027: October 24-27 | Vancouver, BC, Canada'; CHEST states dates/locations subject to change). Attendance left null: only aggregator figures found (5,000+ and 500+), which disagree.

series.standing: THE primary annual meeting for US endocrinology (AACE runs a smaller clinical meeting; ADA and EASD cover diabetes specifically)
series.attendance: ~7,200 ('each ENDO brings together more than 7,200 endocrine clinicians and researchers' - a typical figure, not a 2026 count)
series.note: Official future-meetings page fetched: June 5-7, 2027 (three days). Several third-party listings say June 5-8 - the Endocrine Society's own page and its laureate-awards release both say June 5-7, which is used here. ENDO 2028: June 3-6, Boston.

series.organizer: European Association for the Study of Diabetes
series.standing: 1 of 2 primary global diabetes meetings (the other is the ADA Scientific Sessions); ATTD is the diabetes-technology meeting
series.attendance: ~15,000 ('more than 15,000 delegates from over 130 countries' - a typical figure from a trade listing, not a 2026 count)
series.note: 2027 dates read from search excerpts of easd.org ('21 - 24 September 2027 in Budapest, Hungary'). One third-party listing gives a 20 September start - not used. Attendance figure is third-party and generic; treat as approximate.

series.standing: 1 of 3 primary global cardiology meetings (with ACC and AHA) and the largest of the three
series.attendance: ~33,800 (ESC Congress 2026 Munich: 'more than 33,800 participants', a record; hybrid count)
series.note: 2027 dates read from search excerpts of escardio.org (official). A luminik.io listing shows Munich for 2027 - wrong (Munich hosted 2026). The 33,800 figure appeared in a Sept 1, 2026 press release excerpt; the ESC release URL given is the best match from the search and was not opened directly.

series.audience: Heart-rhythm specialists (cardiac electrophysiologists) and device/ablation teams
series.standing: Subspecialty meeting: THE primary annual meeting for electrophysiology (EHRA is the European counterpart)
series.attendance: ~8,000-10,000 (HRS 2026 press release: 'convenes 10,000'; HRS event page: '8,000+ heart rhythm professionals' in person)
series.note: HRS's own future-meetings page has a typo reading 'May 13-16, 2026'; all other HRS pages say May 13-16, 2027 at the Moscone Center. Attendance figures are HRS's pre-meeting messaging, not a post-event count. Heart Rhythm 2028: May 4-7, Atlanta.

series.standing: THE primary annual meeting for dermatology (AAD also runs a smaller summer Innovation Academy; EADV is the European counterpart)
series.note: 2027 dates read from search excerpts of aad.org ('San Francisco, CA, March 19-23, 2027'). Registration opens 2026-11-18. Attendance left null: AAD's own '2026 Annual Meeting Attendance' page returned 404; the only number found was an aggregator's '20,000+'.

series.standing: THE primary annual meeting for psychiatry (not the American Psychological Association convention, which is a different 'APA')
series.attendance: ~9,000 ('9,000 Psychiatrists & Professionals', per the APA annual-meeting page)
series.note: Official page fetched for 2027. Same dates as the AAN (neurology) 2027 meeting.

series.organizer: Jointly run by the Infectious Diseases Society of America, Society for Healthcare Epidemiology of America, HIV Medicine Association, Pediatric Infectious Diseases Society and Society of Infectious Diseases Pharmacists
series.audience: Infectious-disease doctors, HIV clinicians, hospital epidemiologists and ID pharmacists
series.standing: THE primary annual meeting for US infectious disease (ESCMID Global is the European counterpart; CROI is the HIV research meeting)
series.note: Official page fetched ('Oct. 6-9, in Boston, MA'). Third-party listings still show 2027 as TBD - they are stale. The sponsoring-society list is from general knowledge of the meeting's structure, not from the fetched page.

series.organizer: American Academy of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology
series.standing: 1 of 2 primary US allergy meetings (the other is the ACAAI Annual Scientific Meeting in the fall)
series.note: 2027 dates read from search excerpts of annualmeeting.aaaai.org. Attendance left null: AAAAI's 2026 post-event infographic (linked) exists but the total did not come through in the excerpt; an unofficial ad-platform estimate of ~7,000 was not used.

series.standing: THE primary annual meeting for general surgery / surgeons as a whole (each surgical specialty also has its own meeting)
series.note: 2027 confirmed by fetching facs.org future-congress page (Sat Oct 16 - Tue Oct 19). 2026 dates come from a search excerpt of facs.org, not a direct fetch. Overlaps ANESTHESIOLOGY 2027 (Oct 15-19). Only attendance figure found was an aggregator's '8,500+', not used.

series.standing: THE primary annual meeting for emergency medicine (SAEM and AAEM run smaller meetings)
series.note: Dates read from search excerpts of acep.org future-dates pages ('ACEP27 Scientific Assembly 10/25/2027 - 10/28/2027 Boston, Massachusetts'). A boothsquare.com listing shows Nov 3-7, 2027 - conflicts with ACEP's own pages and is not used. No attendance figure found on two searches.

series.full_name: International Conference on Advanced Technologies & Treatments for Diabetes (ATTD)
series.audience: Diabetes doctors, researchers and device/drug companies focused on diabetes technology (pumps, sensors, automated insulin delivery)

series.attendance: ~5,300-6,000 (ATTD 2026: Kenes says 'over 5,300 participants both in-person and online'; the Barcelona venue CCIB says 'more than 6,000')
series.note: Official page fetched ('3-6 March 2027', Paris). Overlaps AAOS 2027 (Mar 3-6) and AGBT 2027 (Mar 1-4).
